name: pipeline-change-nudge
description: Advisory only, never denies: on the first Edit/Write in a session to a bbm-infrastructure delivery-pipeline file (workflows, scripts/ci, merge-queue config, required-check list, pipeline register), tells the session to read .github/PIPELINE.md, write the PR's Pipeline change statement (step, adds, removes, runner-minutes before/after, back-out) and check that no other pipeline change is in flight (LCH-676).
